era: Arcade and Super Famicom rally racing
summary: Jaleco's Paris-Dakar-inspired rally series, beginning with the 1989 pseudo-3D arcade game and continuing with a Japan-only Super Famicom sequel.

entries.title: Big Run: The Supreme 4WD Challenge: 11e Rallye

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or hardware for the primary route.

primary.why: The first Big Run was a 1989 Jaleco arcade rally game and the first racing game set around the Paris-Dakar rally raid. Amiga and Atari ST are home-computer ports, so the arcade version is the fidelity and reference route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; use Amiga or Atari ST only for home-port comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Distinct from the 1991 Super Famicom sequel, 13e Rallye.

entries.title: Big Run: The Supreme 4WD Challenge: 13e Rallye

emulation.notes: Use accurate Super Famicom emulation or official Nintendo Switch Online access where available.

primary.why: 13e Rallye is the second Big Run game and was released for Super Famicom in Japan. The later Nintendo Switch Online release is an access route, not a sourced content upgrade.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Super Famicom version in bsnes, Mesen, MiSTer, original hardware, or Nintendo Switch Online if available in the relevant region.

entries.remaster_caveats: Japan-only sequel; not the same game as the 1989 arcade 11e Rallye.
